description: Browse the catalog of 260+ audit rules that run during an audit, grouped into categories (crawlability, meta tags, performance, security, accessibility, content, and more). Filter by category code or search by keyword to find what a specific rule checks. Use get_rule for one rule's full detail.

category.description: Filter to one category code (see the categories list in the response).

search.description: Case-insensitive keyword match on rule id, name, and description.

name: list_rules
title: List audit rules
